verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself an official, first-party terminal CLI. It installs via an official script, launches with `claude`, and has subcommands such as `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp serve` and `claude --teleport`. It is composable for piping and CI use, and community users independently confirm it ships as an interactive CLI. missing for 10: a comprehensive command and flag reference (e.g., documented non-interactive/headless flags) in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Claude Code is composable and follows the Unix philosophy. Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools
claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
I do like how this is implemented as a bash tool and not an editor replacement though.
